title: Addiction : How the Family Suffers and What It Can Do?
excerpt: The members of a family are interdependent on each other. Therefore, when there is stress, the whole family readjusts itself to bring stability and balance into their lives. With an addict in the family, the rest of the family members begin to react in predictable ways.
intro: Those who make up a family are dependent on one another. So, when there is a lot of stress, the whole family changes to bring balance and stability back into their lives.
